reason: Credit support under the AI-cloud programme is one programme within q09's total of financing commitments and backstops, and the same FY2027 annual report settles both, so the part-of-a-total boundary does not separate them.

Both ask whether NVIDIA begins shipping its Rubin generation by 2026-12-31.
Both ask for the combined calendar-2026 data-center capex of the four largest AI hyperscalers; only the due date differs, which does not separate them.

Stand-alone CPU sales in FY2027 is the same reported figure as q19's standalone Vera CPU revenue, since Vera is NVIDIA's stand-alone CPU, and the wider wording adds no separate check.
